description: A relation of any fixed finite arity is computably enumerable if and only if it is \(\Sigma_1\)-definable in the standard natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.enumerable_iff_sigmaOne {n : ℕ} (R : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop) :
  REPred R ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticDefinability.SigmaOneDefinable R
